items.title: Game hiccups after surpassing storage limit?
items.text:
Game hiccups after surpassing storage limit?
Has anyone else pulled passed their inventory limit and then the game just takes a shit? I'm not trying to start a quest or anything, I'm literally just trying to navigate my menus and medals to fuse and reduce, and the game freeze frames every few seconds. Like the game is try to process it's own new rule? Is it just me?
Normally, yes. But it's our anniversary so it just feels like a slap in the face.
Thank you so much for replying and acknowledging. It means alot to us.

items.text: Is this actually true? Because i don't have any in my inventory.
I figured it was another error. I just really wish they would fact check these things, it can't be that hard.
Having new content to be excited about has been a breath of fresh air.

I'm hopeful this gets views so I don't have to make a separate thread:

I've reached the point where none of my many tier 2 and most of my tier 3 7* medals aren't being used in subslots anymore. I've dumped alot of jewels into inventory since the anniversary started, and am looking for other opinions on what I should do with these medals. Should I hang on to them in case they decide to increase the subslot amounts? Or is it safe to just sell them? Any thoughts would be appreciated.
You only get 1 ticket for 1000 coins. That's only one medal. Just FYI.
There are free exp medal farms 3 days out of the week every week...if you just get the target egg at the end and your steal procs, that's 12-16 planes in 10 seconds? You're fine.
3x speed and steal makes farming much easier than it used to be. I'll leave you to your unhappiness.
I remember seeing something about a universal trait medal that had a pic of a tier 9 little chef. Was that real? Or was it an April fool's post.
Damn. I got got.
That's why you don't pull unless you have enough for the mercy pull.
Oh shit dawg, that hurts me. Not as much as it hurt you though (ノ｀Д´)ノ彡┻━┻

Get those spicy hot downvotes out of the oven: With the new 3x speed, pvp is still faster than it was even with 5 keyblades. If you don't like the idea of someone beating you in a pvp scenario, then don't play/ care about it. If you already don't play pvp, then why are you complaining in the first place? It's pvp. There are people with better setups. That's life.

Alright, the downvotes should be cooled off and ready now. Dig in.

The consensus seems to be that if you don't have a meta speed medal, then it's worth it. Especially since it's during anniversary and you get other stuff with it. If you already have a good speed medal or two, then probably not worth it.
